# Introduction

Teams now move from analysis toward interpreting and communicating their results.

# Learning goals

1. Interpret project results

2. Evaluate whether results address the original project question

3. Identify limitations and opportunities for improvement

4. Communicate findings clearly

# Lecture - Results & Interpretation

Guidance on interpreting results, evaluating project outcomes, and identifying limitations.

# Lab - Final Project Work

Teams refine their analysis, visualizations, models, and project outputs.

# Discussion - Project Check-in

Peer and instructor feedback on project results and interpretation.

# Assignment

Submit a project progress update and incorporate feedback into the final project.

# Looking ahead

Next week we will focus on **project refinement, communication, and preparing the final deliverables**.
